monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral lockbox decision system covering authorized and excluded users, original-package fit, lock and relock behavior, lost-access recovery, placement, evidence, recalls, acceptance testing, returns, and first-year cost. It adds no merchant, model, price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves the no-purchase outcome.

image_qa.note: Both new pages use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No caregiver, child, dependent adult, cannabis product, lockbox, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report showed 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12, while Delaware, federal-property, and Montana signals had one impression or click apiece; those samples were too weak to redirect the portfolio and existing pages already serve those intents. Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45 and was outside the target 4–20 range. No item is primarily Data-led. The report acted as a cannibalization guard while the batch fills distinct caregiving, household access-control, and mobile-navigation gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis-caregiving handoff plan grounded in current CDC driving and infant-care guidance, New York OCM storage guidance, and National Capital Poison Center response guidance. Its closed-loop handoff, care-job matrix, no-clearance-timer screen, transport gate, two-layer storage system, and exposure-response plan strengthen the responsible-use, driving, child-resistant packaging, older-adult, and social-hosting cluster through reciprocal contextual links. Three narrowly matched educational-resource or technical-feedback opportunities were logged; no outreach was sent.
